_note: M5b closed-loop visual servo protocol for the cutter arm, pre-registered 2026-11-20 BEFORE any vision-control code exists or any vision-mode run. Simulation benchmark on the non-anatomical tissue sheet of scenes/davinci_si_articulated_verified.ttt; not clinical evidence. Criteria must not be loosened after seeing results; failures are reported as failures.
precondition: config/perception/m5a_acceptance.json (user accepted the eight M5a front-availability gate failures, condition: observe-before-act). Any estimator change voids it.

vision_controlled: cutter alignment target (position + jaw axis + opening axis)
scope.proprioception_allowed: the robot's own joint state / forward kinematics (getObjectMatrix of the cutter tcp, frame(), getRCMStats, ECM camera pose). Not GroundTruth. The alignment move is RELATIVE: tcp_fk + (front_fix - 1 mm * dir_est) - tip_est, so a kinematic offset cancels.
scope.truth_allowed_until_M6: cut_line_tension (tension band, incl. the low-threshold switch after cut start), tissue_stats.grasped (instrument-side grasp signal)
scope.truth_safety_monitor_only: tissue_stats torn/max_strain, GroundTruth cut_length for the overcut supervisor and completion_issues (terminal acceptance). Reported separately; never a control input of the cutter.
scope.out_of_scope_still_truth: retractor grasp planning in localize() (cut_front visibility gate + node grasp points) and retract() held check; labelled 'retractor_planning'.

design.front_fix: last valid front estimate (world) with its direction, sheet normal and progress; replaced by every fresh valid estimate; invalidated by any scissors closure, any retractor command (retract/grasp/release/takeover), any camera move, or age > vision.fix_max_age_ticks. Uncommanded injected disturbances (relax/slip) do NOT invalidate it: the controller cannot know of them.
design.observation: vision mode: cut_site_visible = front fix valid; cut_site_offset = projection of the fix; scissors_visible = scissors estimate valid this tick; cut_progress_m = fix progress; tissue_visible = tissue plane valid this tick.
design.clear_view: vision mode, any NEEDS_VIEW state: cut site unknown but scissors and tissue visible -> CLEAR_VIEW (all arms hold). Attempt 1: back off cut.clear_back_m along the jaw axis, jaws unchanged. Attempt 2: full cutter withdrawal if the jaws are closed, else a second back-off. Attempt 3: look only. Front known -> RESUME (attempt counter reset). More than budgets.clear_view_attempts consecutive attempts -> FAILED. Scissors not visible -> OCCLUDED (existing path).
design.align: tool_pose: target from the fix and this tick's tip estimate; combined error = max(lateral distance of the fix from the estimated jaw line, |along gap - 1 mm|); move only if > cut.align_tolerance_m and return the pre-move error, so the next ALIGN tick verifies with a fresh tip estimate.
design.stop: vision mode checks completion at ALIGN entry and at CUT entry on cut_progress_m >= cut.length_m, before any jaw opening.
design.strict_truth_boundary: vision mode: GroundTruth raises on any read not inside a declared purpose (safety_monitor, grasp_signal_and_safety_monitor, tension_until_m6, retractor_planning, scoring).

new_parameters_set_before_runs.perception.camera_pose_error.mode: per_tick (default, M5a semantics) | fixed (drawn once per run: a calibration bias)

unchanged: all tension thresholds, align_tolerance_m 1.5 mm, advance_m 3 mm, length_m 9 mm, max_overcut_m 1 mm, every existing budget, collision envelopes and joint limits.

runs.args: nominal vision, camera_pose_error trans_m 0.001 mode fixed, seed 1
nominal vision, camera_pose_error rot_deg 1.0 mode fixed, seed 1
nominal vision, camera_pose_error trans_m 0.001 mode per_tick, seed 1

runs.expected: FAILED (retraction budget), as in truth mode

runs.args: truth mode, same args as validation/task/m5a_trace_check.json
runs.purpose: control_source=truth must stay trace-identical to the reference

criteria.check: full per-tick trace identical to validation/task/m5a_trace_check.json
no untagged GroundTruth read (strict mode never raised) and truth_reads_by_purpose has no untagged entry

criteria.run: every V_* run that ends DONE
criteria.check: truth cut length in [length_m, length_m + max_overcut_m] = [9, 10] mm
DONE satisfying B3/B4, or FAILED by a fail-closed path (budget / refusal) with no overcut beyond max_overcut_m and no tear; never an overcut or tear
every scissors closure is preceded, on the same tick, by a valid front fix of age <= fix_max_age_ticks and a valid scissors estimate
median truth lateral distance of the true cut front from the true jaw line at closure < align_tolerance_m (1.5 mm); scoring-only truth
report DONE count of 4; gate: >= 3 of 4 DONE, and all 4 satisfy B5

reported_metrics: ticks to DONE vs truth-mode reference
CLEAR_VIEW entries and which attempt restored the view
